summary: Suntree Internal Medicine in Melbourne, Florida identified unusual system activity on September 28, 2025, and immediately contained the incident. Investigation confirmed unauthorized network access with potential file exfiltration affecting 9,810 individuals. Exposed data included names, addresses, treatment information, and health insurance information. Although the incident was not initially characterized as ransomware, the INC Ransom group claimed responsibility on its dark web data leak site and stated that data was exfiltrated. No misuse of patient information had been identified at the time of breach notice.
